# Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  eval = TRUE,
  message = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  dpi = 150,
  out.width = "100%"
)

project_dir <- params$project_dir
results_dir <- file.path(params$project_dir, params$results_dir)
data_dir <- file.path(params$project_dir, params$data_dir)
cache_dir <- file.path(data_dir, params$cache_dir)

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_dir)
dir.create(results_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

options(bitmapType = "cairo")
```
